scientific_source.provenance_constraint: The counterfactual observation is benchmark-generated process-control evidence on the frozen 274-day L2 observation scaffold. It must never be described as a historical NaI measurement made in a stellar plasma.

observation_model.fixed_response_assumption: Detector geometry/response and any time-independent branching/yield factor are absorbed into amplitude A.
observation_model.known_identifiability_caveat: An arbitrary exponential detector-efficiency drift is mathematically degenerate with a changed decay constant. The dossier must state the time-stationary-response assumption rather than claiming the curve alone excludes arbitrary drift.
